_comment: The browser build of the modules (build_modules.py). engine_cxxflags MUST equal the flags poly-editor compiles its linked-in engines with in its wasm host (editor_flags_from), or an engine module is not bit identical to the linked-in engine. An insert has no linked-in twin, its reference is the device build run by emu_plug.py: wasm has no fused multiply-add, so a source the ARM compiler fuses (Dirt's 1 + 15 d^2 at -Os) can differ by one ulp in a coefficient. emcc is pinned: another compiler version may schedule float code differently (it cannot reorder it, wasm has no fast math by default, but libcall simplification can change).
